title: ThermalSim Job Configuration
description: Configuration schema for ThermalSim headless simulations (accepted by headless_api.py and thermalsim_cli.py).

power_pads.description: Manual heat sources. Accepts either an array of pad descriptors or an object mapping 'REF.PAD' to Watts (number) or a PWL file path (string).

power_w.description: Constant dissipation in Watts (number or string) or PWL file path.

power.description: Constant dissipation in Watts (e.g. 5.0, '5W') or PWL file path.

pwl.description: Path to a piecewise-linear (.pwl/.csv/.txt) time-power profile.

oneOf.description: Mapping of 'REF.PAD' (e.g. 'U1.37') to constant Watts (number/string) or PWL file path.

steady_state.description: Solve directly for final steady-state temperature (K*T = Q + b). Defaults to true when 'time' is omitted and no PWL profile is used; false otherwise.

time.description: Transient simulation duration in seconds (used when steady_state is false).

amb.description: Ambient surrounding temperature in degrees Celsius.

res.description: Desired spatial grid cell size in mm. Defaults to the board's recommended_res_mm from inspect_board.

thick.description: Fallback total PCB thickness in mm when stackup dielectric thickness is unavailable.

h_conv.description: Top surface (and default bottom) effective heat transfer coefficient (convection + radiation) in W/(m^2*K).

h_conv_bottom.description: Bottom surface effective heat transfer coefficient (convection + radiation) in W/(m^2*K). Defaults to h_conv when omitted or null.

via_plating_um.description: Via and PTH barrel copper plating wall thickness in micrometers (5.0 to 100.0 um).

via_fill.description: Via fill type: 'plated' for standard hollow/resin-filled plated barrels, or 'copper' for solid copper-filled vias.

grid_detail_level.description: Total solver node budget preset: fast (1M), balanced (3M), detailed (8M), very_detailed (16M), or custom.

grid_node_budget.description: Explicit maximum total solver nodes across all layers (derived from grid_detail_level when omitted).

mesh_mode.description: Deprecated compatibility field; ThermalSim v0.4.7+ always uses compact uniform meshing.

adaptive_max_cell_ratio.description: Deprecated compatibility field ignored since v0.4.7.

limit_area.description: Crop the solver domain around active heat sources and complete active current nets.

pad_dist_mm.description: Thermal margin in mm around active sources/nets when limit_area is true.

area_mode.description: Domain mode ('full' for entire board, 'active' to crop around active sources/nets).

ignore_traces.description: Exclude copper tracks from the thermal conductivity map (zones and pads remain).

show_all.description: Include all copper layers in generated visual plots.

snapshots.description: Save intermediate transient temperature snapshot images.

snap_count.description: Number of intermediate snapshots in transient mode when snapshots is true.

use_heatsink.description: Enable thermal pad / heatsink boundary on User.Eco1 shapes. Auto-enabled if pad_sink_mode is 'heatsink' or any heatsink_* key is set.

pad_sink_mode.description: Boundary model for User.Eco1 thermal pad: 'fixed' sink temperature or 'heatsink' (dynamic 0D lumped heatsink). Auto-defaults to 'heatsink' when heatsink_rth_kw is set.

pad_th.description: Thermal interface pad thickness in mm.

pad_k.description: Thermal interface pad thermal conductivity in W/(m*K).

pad_cap_areal.description: Thermal interface pad areal heat capacity in J/(m^2*K).

pad_contact_factor.description: Effective thermal interface contact factor (0.05 to 1.0).

pad_sink_temp_use_ambient.description: Use ambient temperature (amb) as the fixed sink temperature when pad_sink_mode is 'fixed'.

pad_sink_temp_c.description: Fixed sink temperature in degrees Celsius when pad_sink_mode is 'fixed' and pad_sink_temp_use_ambient is false.

heatsink_rth_kw.description: Dynamic 0D heatsink-to-ambient thermal resistance in K/W.

heatsink_material.description: Heatsink material preset used to determine specific heat capacity c_p.

heatsink_mass_g.description: Heatsink mass in grams (0 models an instantaneous zero-thermal-mass heatsink).

heatsink_cp_j_kgk.description: Heatsink specific heat capacity c_p in J/(kg*K) (used when heatsink_material is 'custom').

current_enabled.description: Enable DC current-flow simulation for copper Joule (I^2*R) heating.

electro_thermal_coupling.description: Enable iterative electro-thermal coupling (updating copper resistivity rho_cu(T) from the solved 3D temperature field when max rise exceeds 5 C).

current_flows.description: Pad-to-pad DC current flows (1->1, 1->N, N->M). Accepts canonical GUI flow objects or compact pad selectors (e.g. {'from': ['J1.1'], 'to': {'U1.1': 3.0, 'U2.1': 3.0}} or {'from': ['J1.1'], 'to': ['U1.1', 'U1.2'], 'current_a': 12.0, 'to_sharing': 'equipotential'}).

total_current_a.description: Total flow current magnitude in Amperes from source pads to sink pads.

from_sharing.description: How current is distributed across source ('from') pads.

to_sharing.description: How current is distributed across sink ('to') pads.

from.description: Compact source pad selector (list of 'REF.PAD' strings/descriptors or mapping of 'REF.PAD' to current in Amperes).

to.description: Compact sink pad selector (list of 'REF.PAD' strings/descriptors or mapping of 'REF.PAD' to current in Amperes).

from_pads.description: Canonical list of source pad descriptors.

to_pads.description: Canonical list of sink pad descriptors.

current_groups.description: Legacy DC current terminal groups (supported when current_flows is empty). Each active net must balance to 0 A.

mode.description: Whether currents are specified per pad or split evenly from total_current_a.

total_current_a.description: Total group current in Amperes when mode is 'total'.

pads.description: Terminal pads in this current group.

current_a.description: Signed DC current in Amperes (+ enters PCB, - leaves PCB).

limits.description: Optional thermal pass/fail limits evaluated against simulation results.

max_board_c.description: Maximum allowed board peak temperature in degrees Celsius.

max_heatsink_c.description: Maximum allowed dynamic heatsink temperature in degrees Celsius.

components.description: Mapping of component reference glob pattern (e.g. 'U1', 'C*') to max allowed temperature in degrees Celsius.

power_scale.description: Optional multiplier applied to constant pad powers for what-if studies.

copper_thickness_scale.description: Optional multiplier applied to stackup copper thicknesses for what-if studies.

refill_zones.description: Automatically refill unfilled copper zones in memory via pcbnew.ZONE_FILLER before simulating.
